note: Seed moves and recipes. locale_prefix x listing_root compose listing paths; tries/wins are priors from a live check of 417 sites on 2026-10-03, and your own traffic keeps scoring them. hosts{} holds only what a site does differently: needs rendering, its verified listing and locale, item url patterns proven by a catalogue, its detail suffix, or a wall it put up. Recipes are compiled plans a small model runs in one call.

access.name: LexisNexis written permission (its terms forbid automated access)
access.terms: "Access or use the Online Services via mechanical, programmatic, robotic, scripted or any other automated means is strictly prohibited without our express prior written permission"; this covers AI agents too. Ask for written permission or a bulk copy
access.notes: Several states publish their official code only through LexisNexis public access (Mississippi, for one). Public.Resource.Org's scans of state codes on archive.org are an older alternative.

access.name: Alaska DCCED/DCRA Community Database (ArcGIS REST)
access.terms: State of Alaska open data; ArcGIS paging limits (maxRecordCount)
access.notes: alaskacountyoffices.org is an unofficial aggregator (Alaska has boroughs/census areas, not counties). DCRA is authoritative for borough names/boundaries; office phone/hours data would come from each borough's own site, not this layer.

access.name: Amazon S3 bucket (owner unknown)
access.terms: Private bucket; individual objects may be public only by exact key
access.notes: Not a bot challenge: S3 returns AccessDenied XML (listing disabled / object not public). Owner/purpose not identifiable via search; nothing to route to.

access.name: Cambridge Dictionaries API (retired)
access.terms: n/a
access.notes: Former API host dictionary-api.cambridge.org now 301s to dictionary.cambridge.org; no current public/dev API found. Data licensing may exist by contact with Cambridge University Press (unverified).

access.name: eCFR API (legacy host superseded by www.ecfr.gov) + GovInfo eCFR bulk XML
access.terms: Public domain; no key. Bulk alternative: https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/ECFR (daily XML per title)
access.notes: ecfr.federalregister.gov redirects to the Federal Register's own 'Request Access' page (unblock.federalregister.gov); the same data is open at www.ecfr.gov/api. Bulk XML: https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/ECFR

access.name: LegiScan Public API (pull)
access.terms: Free tier reported cut on 2026-10-01 to 10,000 queries/month at ~2 req/s; CC BY 4.0 attribution required; from 2026-11-01 keys that re-download unchanged datasets get banned. Figures come from a third-party pull request (legiscan.com blocks fetchers): confirm at signup
access.notes: Requires free LegiScan account login before key creation. Manual: api.legiscan.com/dl/LegiScan_API_User_Manual.pdf. 10k/2 req/s figures come from a downstream repo PR, not LegiScan's page (which 403s fetchers).

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Maryland General Assembly statute text
access.notes: api/Laws/GetSections lists an article's sections; Laws/StatuteText?article=<code>&section=<n> is one section. 36 articles, ~40,000 sections; the official text has no catchlines. No robots.txt.

access.name: WordPress RSS feed + WP REST API
access.terms: Platform-default endpoints; no published terms; content copyright the site
access.notes: WordPress blog (not Shopify -- /products.json is challenged 403). /feed/ and /wp-json/wp/v2/posts both 200 while pages challenge; WP JSON gives full content.rendered.

access.name: RS e-procurement integration (web service API / PunchOut / cXML)
access.terms: Trade-account customers only; pricing per customer's commercial conditions
access.notes: No public self-service product API or developer portal for RS/RS Americas found; datasheets on docs.rs-online.com are linkable PDFs, not an API.

access.name: NY Unified Court System file host (no API)
access.terms: Public court documents
access.notes: The suggested alternative www.nycourts.gov is behind the same Cloudflare challenge. No UCS API/feed found for forms, handbooks, part rules. For decisions only: CourtListener (token) or NY Law Reporting Bureau -- different content.

access.name: Acronym Finder licensed web service (XML/SOAP)
access.terms: Fees based on number of users; custom/co-branded and unlimited licenses by quote
access.notes: Licensing page itself 403s to fetchers; terms taken from search snippet of that page.

access.name: ARCAT official MCP server
access.terms: Official (com.arcat in MCP registry, owner of arcat.com); tools: browse_csi_sections, search_manufacturers, get_manufacturer, search_products
access.notes: ARCAT runs an official MCP server (mcp.arcat.com/mcp, registry com.arcat) that needs an API key, but no page says where to get one and directories report ~2% uptime (2026-09). Recheck later.

access.name: Town of Arlington RSS feeds (Vision CMS) + Arlington GIS Data Hub DCAT
access.terms: Public municipal content; no published limits
access.notes: RSS served unchallenged on the same host (ctID=5 = News; other ctIDs for calendar/meetings listed on the docs page). GIS open data: gis-arlingtonma.opendata.arcgis.com/api/feed/dcat-us/1.1.json tested 200.

access.name: B&H Affiliate Program (MyAffiliateProgram portal)
access.terms: Application reviewed by B&H; the affiliate agreement governs use. UNVERIFIED: a product data feed for affiliates is reported only by third-party directories, so confirm it exists before relying on it
access.notes: No public product API found. A product data feed for affiliates is claimed only by third-party directories -- unverified. Otherwise route is none.

access.name: Britannica Syndication API
access.terms: Free for non-commercial use, 1,000 queries/day per key; commercial terms case by case. The developer site's footer is dated 2022, so check it is still current
access.notes: Evaluation key per product ('Article Type'); /article/{id}/xml returns article XML. Developer site footer dated 2022 -- may be stale; commercial syndication via form01.britannica.com/help/syndicationform.html.

access.name: DigiKey Product Information API v4
access.terms: Token URL https://api.digikey.com/v1/oauth2/token (10-min tokens); 120 req/min, 1,000 req/day; API User Agreement
access.notes: Register, create an organization app, subscribe it to Product Information v4; sandbox at sandbox-api.digikey.com.

access.name: DMP literature CDN (assets.dmp.com)
access.terms: DMP-copyrighted documents; no published reuse terms
access.notes: No public DMP API (Virtual Keypad/Dealer Admin integrations are partner-only). Product sheets/manuals are served unchallenged from assets.dmp.com by document number; pages on www.dmp.com are not.

access.name: DailyMed SPL API (NLM) + openFDA + RxNav/RxNorm
access.terms: Public domain US gov data; openFDA no-key 240 req/min & 1,000/day per IP; RxNav asks <=20 req/s
access.notes: Drugs.com has no public API (content licensed from Cerner Multum etc.). Also tested 200: api.fda.gov/drug/label.json and rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/REST/drugs.json. Label text = FDA source, not Drugs.com's consumer prose.

access.name: eCFR API (versioner/search/admin)
access.terms: US government public domain; no key; no published hard rate limit (be polite); eCFR is editorial, not the official legal edition
access.notes: Tested /api/versioner/v1/titles.json and /api/search/v1/results (both 200 JSON) from this machine while the HTML pages challenge; full-text XML via /api/versioner/v1/full/{date}/title-N.xml.

access.name: WooCommerce Store API (platform default)
access.terms: Platform-default public endpoint; no published site terms for it
access.notes: WooCommerce site; Cloudflare challenges every path, including its Store API and product feed.

access.name: Guitar Center affiliate program (CJ Affiliate / Impact product feed)
access.terms: Advertiser approval required; feed use limited to affiliate promotion. UNVERIFIED: third-party sources disagree on the network (CJ vs Impact) and no official page confirms a product feed
access.notes: No public API. Third-party sources disagree on network (CJ vs Impact); feed availability not confirmed from an official page.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Illinois Compiled Statutes, act full-text pages
access.notes: details?ActID=<id>&ChapAct=FullText, one table per section. robots.txt Crawl-delay 10: the whole ILCS takes ~8 h.

access.name: LexisNexis written permission (its terms forbid automated access)
access.terms: "Access or use the Online Services via mechanical, programmatic, robotic, scripted or any other automated means is strictly prohibited without our express prior written permission"; this covers AI agents too. Ask for written permission or a bulk copy
access.notes: Several states publish their official code only through LexisNexis public access (Mississippi, for one). Public.Resource.Org's scans of state codes on archive.org are an older alternative.

access.name: Merriam-Webster Dictionary API
access.terms: Free non-commercial only, 1,000 queries/day per key, max 2 reference APIs; MW logo required; commercial use needs a license
access.notes: JSON only; two keys issued at registration.

access.name: NYT RSS feeds (plus NYT Developer APIs with free key)
access.terms: RSS free for personal/non-commercial use with attribution; Developer APIs (Article Search, Top Stories, etc.) need a free key (api-key query param), ~5 req/min, 500/day
access.notes: RSS gives headline, summary and link only. Full-text search needs the free NYT Developer API key (api-key query param) from https://developer.nytimes.com/get-started; its rate limits were not re-checked.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Texas Statutes code downloads (one zip of chapter HTML per code)
access.notes: The JSON lists 31 codes; each is <CODE>.htm.zip of chapter files cut at section anchors. The whole statutes in 31 requests.

access.terms: Offered for personal use. C.R.S. 2-5-118 asks anyone republishing the statutes to file a statement with the Committee on Legal Services, which also provides the official data set on request.
access.name: Colorado Revised Statutes title download (OLLS)
access.notes: Every title as HTML, 37 MB. The official online C.R.S. is LexisNexis-hosted; this download is the legislature's own copy. robots.txt disallows only /crs-archive/.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Utah Code XML, one file per title
access.notes: code.html names the current version; each title is Title<t>/<version>.xml. robots.txt Crawl-delay 10. The server omits its intermediate certificate: fetch it from the AIA url, never disable verification.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Code of Virginia per-title CSV (Virginia Law Library)
access.notes: CoVTitle_<N>.csv per title, each section's HTML body in a column: 76 requests instead of 33,000 pages. Unpaced section-page crawling gets 403 (a throttle, not a UA rule). Section pages carry the LIS menu; cut the law box.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: North Dakota Century Code, whole code on one page
access.notes: 46 MB HTML, one div.section per section; subsection numbers are drawn by list styles, so write them back into the text.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Nebraska statutes range view (400 sections per request)
access.notes: Ids from browse-chapters.php?chapter=N, ranges in the range view's own sort order. One page per statute at the robots Crawl-delay of 3 s is ~41 h; ranges are ~16 min. Comma ids (2-10,100) exist.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: South Dakota Legislature Statutes API
access.notes: Each title as one HTML document: /api/Statutes/<t>.html?all=true. Served as UTF-16LE with no byte-order mark: decode it explicitly.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Maine Revised Statutes per-title .docx
access.notes: All 64 titles, lettered ones too (7-A, 39-A). Sections start at bold paragraphs; some are printed twice (current and future): keep the one in force.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes, full-title HTML
access.notes:
view-statute?txtType=HTM&ttl=&iFrame=true is a whole title; sections open at the publisher's marker
18c301s
. ttl=0 is the Constitution.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Wyoming Statutes, Rocket NXT publication
access.notes: Walk the XML table of contents (f=xmlcontents, getchildren, depth=1); each chapter document once as HTML. The title PDFs are larger than common PDF readers' text caps.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Minnesota Statutes full chapter pages
access.notes: One div.section per section; section pages carry the revisor's menu and version list, cut the law box.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: California legislative bulk data (pubinfo)
access.notes: 1.28 GB: stream it to disk. LAW_SECTION_TBL.dat names code, section and file; each section's text is a separate .lob entry. leginfo.legislature.ca.gov itself answers with a Cloudflare challenge.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Guam Code Annotated chapter PDFs (Compiler of Laws)
access.notes: ~800 chapter and UCC-division PDFs. Large chapters exceed 200,000 characters of text. guamcourts.org now redirects here.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Puerto Rico OGP Biblioteca Virtual, consolidated laws (Leyes de referencia)
access.notes: The index data on main_view.aspx lists ~14,000 documents; ~2,500 are consolidated laws as amended. The 1930 Civil Code was repealed by Ley 55-2020. No robots.txt.

access.terms: Norma Terms of Use prohibit use 'via automated mechanisms, in particular for bulk downloading of documents' without Lexum's prior written consent.
access.name: Lexum written consent (NMOneSource terms forbid automated mechanisms)
access.notes: Official free source of NMSA 1978 (New Mexico Compilation Commission). One EPUB per chapter (/w/nmos/n-<id>-en.epub), ~130 files; ask Lexum and the Commission for consent or a bulk file.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Ohio Revised Code site (robots.txt disallows all)
access.notes: robots.txt is the single line 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' with the newline missing, so parsers read no rules; the intent is disallow-all. No other official copy found (legislature.ohio.gov links here). Ask the Legislative Service Commission.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Oklahoma Statutes (robots.txt disallows all)
access.notes: robots.txt disallows / and *.pdf; the title PDFs live at /OK_Statutes/CompleteTitles/. oscn.net disallows all crawlers too. Ask the Legislative Service Bureau.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Tennessee Code: official copy is LexisNexis-hosted
access.notes: robots.txt disallows all; the official code redirects to advance.lexis.com, whose terms forbid automation. Ask the Tennessee Code Commission.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Arkansas Code: official copy is LexisNexis-hosted
access.notes: The legislature publishes Acts, not the code. The Arkansas Code Revision Commission grants reproduction permission.

access.terms: Official government publication
access.name: Virgin Islands Code: official copy is LexisNexis-hosted
access.notes: The legislature's site links to the LexisNexis public-access container; ask the Legislature of the Virgin Islands.
